//: Satellite imagery is ~2 TB in full — too large to mirror. Keep only z0-16
locally (~700 GB) and serve z17+ straight from the CDN, stacked via VPL.
build: convert only z0-16 from the CDN into the local subset.
serveCurrent: local subset for z0-16, CDN for z17+ (first-match + filters).
serveTransitional defaults to remote (whole dataset from the CDN while rebuilding).
name: satellite

serveCurrent.pipeline: from_stacked [ from_container filename="{LOCAL}/satellite.versatiles" | filter level_max=16, from_container filename="{CDN}/satellite.versatiles" | filter level_min=17 ]
